name: radio-group
title: Radio group
description: One of a few, all in view: square 16px boxes with an ink square in the picked one, rows 28px with a label and an optional hint.
use_for: Two to five options that each need a line: a reading mode, a region, a plan.
never: More than five options (use NativeSelect or Menu)
source: New in Conare's style: the field's hairline (console2.css .v2-input), the switch's ink and red focus (.v2-switch)
body: Native radios drawn square, so arrows move the pick and the group is one Tab stop. `options` are `{ value, label, hint?, disabled? }`, `label` names the group, `inline` lays them in a row. The picked box takes an ink edge and its 8px square settles in from 0.6 in 120ms (reduced motion fades it). Focus is the switch's red outline.
